title: Beyond the Agent Harness: Boundary Criteria for Software-Factory Orchestration - A Single-Operator Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.06946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Several recent systems add a layer above the coding-agent harness that organises many agent runs into continuous delivery. The existence of such a layer is not our contribution. What is missing is a rule for deciding which layer a mechanism or a failure belongs to. We propose boundary criteria based on an operational definition of a run. A mechanism confined to one run belongs to the agent harness. One that coordinates runs, hands state from one run to a later one, or is updated from run outcomes belongs to a factory harness. One that must change with the application domain belongs to the domain layer. Two residual tests assign infrastructure and model causes. For failures, we code where the defect originated, which control failed to stop it, and where it was fixed as three separate fields, and we require positive evidence before attributing a failure to the environment. translated_title: 超越智能体框架：软件工厂编排的边界判据——一项单操作员案例研究
translated_abstract: 近年来出现的若干系统在编码智能体框架之上增加了一个层次，将众多智能体运行组织为持续交付。这一层次的存在本身并非我们的贡献；所缺失的，是一条用于判定某个机制或故障应归属于哪一层的规则。我们基于对“运行”的操作性定义提出了边界判据：局限于单次运行的机制属于智能体框架；协调多次运行、将状态从一次运行传递至后续运行、或依据运行结果进行更新的机制属于工厂框架；必须随应用领域而改变的机制属于领域层。另有两项残余测试用于归派基础设施与模型方面的原因。对于故障，我们将缺陷起源之处、哪个控制环节未能阻止它、以及它最终在哪里被修复编码为三个相互独立的字段，并且在将故障归因于环境之前要求有明确的正面证据。我们在来自单一操作员的已记录故障数据上开发了这些判据。
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是提出了一套基于“运行”操作性定义的边界判据，用以明确判定软件工厂编排中的机制与故障究竟归属于智能体框架、工厂框架、领域层还是基础设施/模型层。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is a set of boundary criteria, grounded in an operational definition of a run, for deciding whether a mechanism or failure belongs to the agent harness, the factory harness, the domain layer, or infrastructure/model causes in software-factory orchestration.
